# The calendar week view never destroys its event DragZone

## Context

Found while reviewing PR #20369. That PR's month-view plugin copies this plugin's shape, gap included.

## The Problem

`Neo.calendar.view.week.plugin.DragDrop#getEventDragZone` creates an `EventDragZone` on the first event drag and stores it on `owner.eventDragZone`. Nothing destroys it. The plugin has no `destroy()`, and `week.Component#destroy` only clears `timeAxis`.

A `DragZone` registers with the main thread's `DragDrop` addon when it is constructed, and only its `destroy()` unregisters it. The JSDoc at the unregister call explains the cost: a stale registration "silently misattributes a later gesture to a destroyed zone". So once a week view is destroyed, its zone stays registered.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/calendar/view/week/plugin/DragDrop.mjs` l.76–110: `getEventDragZone`, the creator.
- `src/draggable/DragZone.mjs` l.211 registers the zone at construction; `destroy()` (l.220–235) unregisters it.
- `src/component/Base.mjs` l.1447: a component destroys its plugins, so a plugin `destroy()` runs together with the view's.
- `src/core/Base.mjs` `destroy()` deletes the instance's own properties, but doesn't destroy the instances they reference.

## The Fix

Give `Neo.calendar.view.week.plugin.DragDrop` a `destroy()` that destroys `owner.eventDragZone` when it exists, clears the reference, and calls `super.destroy()`. The creator ends the lifetime it started.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] After a drag created the zone, destroying the week view also destroys that zone (unit: the zone's `isDestroyed` is `true` afterwards).
- [ ] Destroying a week view that never had a drag doesn't throw (unit).

## Out of Scope

- The month view's plugin, which PR #20369 covers.
- The week view's `EventResizable` plugin.

- PR #20369
